sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (uncensored EXL3) — one DGX Spark
sources.snippet: A single docker compose up away from serving Qwen3.8-Flash-Next — the uncensored EXL3 re-quant — on an NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, aarch64), with an OpenAI-compatible API and speculative decoding on. Same workflow as the GLM-5.3-Flash DGX image: get the image, mount the model, talk to it like a cloud model.
